summary: Callum knows only the chorus of the town's gentle evening song. He chooses to sing it softly beside Aunt Mae, and his small voice helps the circle stay together.

title: Anya's Plums Along the Walk
youtube_title: Anya's Plums Along the Walk | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing tastes sweeter when there is enough left for the next person too.
summary: Anya brings plums from the backyard tree on the town lantern walk. She offers them one by one to neighbors and musicians, saving a few to share at home.

title: Theo Listens After the Song
youtube_title: Theo Listens After the Song | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder stays when you listen to the quiet that follows the music.
summary: When the festival's quiet music ends, Theo stays a little longer and listens to spoons, crickets, paper lanterns, and one last flute breath become a new kind of song.

title: The Picnic Basket Pulley
youtube_title: The Picnic Basket Pulley | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: When people share the pulling and the planning, a heavy basket can rise smoothly.
summary: Basil and Cleo want to bring a picnic basket up to a low platform without squashing the sandwiches. With Nana's help they build a small pulley. The basket tilts on the first try, so they add a second loop, and the picnic rides up steady and straight.

title: The String and Cup Telephone
youtube_title: The String and Cup Telephone | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A quiet voice can still reach a friend when you try, and when the string is pulled tight.
summary: Dina wants to tell Ekon a bedtime joke, but her voice feels too small to call across the gap. They build a string-and-cup telephone. The first try fails because the string is slack. With Papa's help they tighten it, and Dina bravely sends her joke through the cup.

title: The Jar That Counted Rain
youtube_title: The Jar That Counted Rain | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity means looking closely, asking questions, and checking your idea in more than one place.
summary: Fatima and Gus wonder how much rain fell in the night. They make a simple rain gauge from a clear jar. A second jar under a leafy bush collects less, and they discover that where you put the jar changes what it tells you.

title: The Rolling Book Box
youtube_title: The Rolling Book Box | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing stories is easier when we carry them carefully and leave enough for everyone.
summary: Helena and Ivo build a homemade book cart from a shallow crate, cardboard sides, and spool wheels so they can share picture books with Jamila. On the first roll, a book slides off. They add higher sides and a soft strap, then deliver the books with a smile.

title: A Gentle Ramp for Oranges
youtube_title: A Gentle Ramp for Oranges | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A kind errand works best when we make the path gentle enough for what we carry.
summary: Jamila and Kostas want to bring oranges to a neighbor, but their wagon stops at a low step. They build a ramp. The first ramp is too steep and the fruit rolls. They make the ramp longer and gentler, with Papa checking that it will not slip, and the oranges arrive safely.

title: The Picture Labels
youtube_title: The Picture Labels | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth about a mix-up helps everyone find the right jar.
summary: Luna moves the kitchen jars while dusting and then feels worried. Malik almost spreads spicy pickle on bread. Luna tells the truth. Together, with Mama's help, they taste carefully and make picture labels so every jar tells the truth on the outside.

title: The Bell at the Garden Gate
youtube_title: The Bell at the Garden Gate | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small, clear hello can help a neighbor know that kindness is at the gate.
summary: Neri and Oscar visit a neighbor who cannot hear soft knocks while working in the back garden. They hang a small bell by the gate. At first it stays quiet because it is still wrapped in cloth. They uncover it, ring a friendly hello, and share lemonade among the herbs.

title: The Bench Between Yards
youtube_title: The Bench Between Yards | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Shared tools stay useful when everyone takes a turn and puts each thing back.
summary: Paz and Qadir make a shared tool bench from a sturdy crate so their string, tape, and clothespins have homes. They both grab the tape and tangle it. A turn card and labeled cups fix the problem, and together they steady a wobbly plant stake for the yard.

title: Planks Over the Puddle
youtube_title: Planks Over the Puddle | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork can make a simple, steady path when everyone goes slowly and checks the wobbly parts.
summary: Rita and Soren want to carry cookies to Grandpa's porch, but a wide shallow puddle covers the lane. With his help they lay planks across it. The first plank rocks, so they add a second plank and flat stones at each end. The cookies stay dry, and they cross together.

title: A Soft Hello for the Kitten
youtube_title: A Soft Hello for the Kitten | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a new friend come closer when the room stays gentle and unhurried.
summary: Tova and Wynn welcome a new kitten who hides when they rush and speak loudly. They build a soft cardboard nook and a slow ribbon toy. They wait without grabbing. The kitten comes out to the warm spot, and they learn that a gentle hello takes time.

title: The Nap Time Basket
youtube_title: The Nap Time Basket | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience and gentle hands help a baby rest and help a family stay calm.
summary: Fatima and Oscar want to help when a new baby sibling is napping. They make a low basket cart of folded cloths and a paper sign that asks for soft feet. The cart squeaks, so they pad the wheels. Mama hangs a slow paper mobile aside from the crib, and the baby keeps resting.

title: The Note Slide
youtube_title: The Note Slide | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A creative idea can be fixed with careful looking, and then it carries kind words.
summary: Gus and Neri build a gentle cardboard chute from a window box to a porch basket so thank-you notes can slide down. The first note jams at a dent. With Papa's help they smooth the tube and widen the opening, and a note about borrowed chalk arrives with a papery whoosh.

title: The Sunflower Measuring Stick
youtube_title: The Sunflower Measuring Stick | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Nature shows us more when we look at the living plant and not only at its shadow.
summary: Oscar and Paz want to see how their sunflower grows. They mark a stick, but an evening shadow tricks them into thinking the plant shrank. The next morning they measure the stem itself with a level string and Grandpa's help, and they notice bees, scent, and rough leaves along the way.

title: Circles for Cookies
youtube_title: Circles for Cookies | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honesty means telling the truth about an uneven share and then making it fair.
summary: Qadir and Luna are packing cookies for neighbors. Qadir quietly gives his favorite plate two extra cookies, then tells Luna the truth. They make a cardboard board of circles so each cookie has one home, recount honestly, and deliver even shares, with a thank-you plate for Nana.

title: The Cardboard Wind Arrow
youtube_title: The Cardboard Wind Arrow | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity asks what the wind is doing and then checks the feeling on your own cheek.
summary: Malik and Rita build a cardboard wind arrow to help them hang laundry where it will dry. The arrow sticks at first. With Auntie's help they loosen it safely, and then they test what they see against the cool breeze on their faces. The sheets dry, and their curiosity has a simple tool.

title: Small Holes and Soft Water
youtube_title: Small Holes and Soft Water | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Nature thrives with gentle care, and a kind tool can be made softer when the first try is too strong.
summary: Soren and Tova water a neighbor's seedlings while she is at the library. With a grown-up they make a bottle sprinkler. Too many holes make the water gush, so they tape some shut until the shower is soft. The soil darkens, the leaves smell green, and the seedlings are ready for their neighbor's return.

title: The Porch Book Walk
youtube_title: The Porch Book Walk | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship grows when we walk together, fix a mix-up, and save a page to share.
summary: Wynn and Jamila set out to return borrowed books, but the books go toward the wrong porches. They notice, tell each other, and make simple name cards. Then they deliver each book to the right friend, including Ivo, and read one page together on his step.

title: The Paper Breeze
youtube_title: The Paper Breeze | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Creativity can cool a problem, and patience still tells us when something is ready.
summary: Kostas and Fatima want to carry honey bread to a neighbor, but the pan is still warm. They invent a paper fan on a stick to stir the air. The first fan is too small, so they make a bigger folded one. They still wait until Papa says the pan is cool enough to touch, and then the bread goes out golden and safe.

title: Cards on the Kindness Line
youtube_title: Cards on the Kindness Line | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small card clipped where a neighbor will see your true thanks.
summary: Ivo wants to thank a neighbor for lemons but feels shy. With Basil he hangs painted cards on a short line. The wind takes one card, so they add a second pin. Ivo finds the courage to clip his own thank-you where it can be read, and the neighbor answers with a wave.

title: The Welcome Mat
youtube_title: The Welcome Mat | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can sound like a quiet hello when you try again and bring a small kindness with you.
summary: Ekon feels shy about greeting Dina, who has just moved into the calm house next door. He and Papa paint a simple cardboard welcome mat, and Ekon brings a labeled jar of crackers. His first hello is too quiet to hear. He tries again, Dina answers, and they share the crackers on the step.

title: Alba and the Goat Who Wanted a Hat
youtube_title: Alba and the Goat Who Wanted a Hat | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness notices a friend's wish and answers it in a way that stays gentle and free.
summary: Alba sees that Bramble the goat is curious about sun hats. With the grown-up, she sews a light loose hat the goat can wear or shake off. They walk the meadow together, and Alba learns that kindness means helping a wish without ever making a friend feel stuck.

title: Bastian and the Right Snack for Ducks
youtube_title: Bastian and the Right Snack for Ducks | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Caring for nature means offering the right food and not wasting what we already have.
summary: Bastian wants to feed the ducks a bag of old bread. He learns bread is not a healthy food for ducks. He does not dump it. Good slices become toast for people, and dry ends go into the compost. He brings oats and peas instead, and the ducks eat calmly at the pond.

title: Corin Packs a Light Picnic for Moss
youtube_title: Corin Packs a Light Picnic for Moss | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork means planning together so every helper, including a donkey, stays comfortable.
summary: Corin and friends want a meadow picnic, and Moss the donkey offers to carry the basket. They work as a team to pack only a light load, walk beside Moss, and share the unpacking so the outing stays easy and kind.

title: Delphine Shares a Row with the Rabbits
youtube_title: Delphine Shares a Row with the Rabbits | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing works best when there is a clear, kind plan so everyone has enough.
summary: Delphine wants lettuce for a salad, but rabbits also nibble the garden border. She marks one clover row to share and one row to keep. Sitting quietly, she learns that sharing can be generous and still be fair.

title: Emeka Stands Still like the Heron
youtube_title: Emeka Stands Still like the Heron | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets you notice small wonders you would miss if you hurried.
summary: Emeka wants the patient heron to move and play. He learns to stand quietly instead. By waiting, he sees leaf boats, ripples, and a dragonfly, and the heron offers a calm turn of the head. Emeka discovers that patience is a way of being a good guest.

title: Flora Watches the Bees from the Path
youtube_title: Flora Watches the Bees from the Path | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity is wonderful when we look closely and still give wild neighbors plenty of room.
summary: Flora hears bees in the clover and wants to see their work. With a grown-up she stays on the path, draws what she notices, and learns that careful distance is part of being curious. She leaves the flowers for the bees and brings her drawing home.

title: Gideon and the Dog's Quiet Hello
youtube_title: Gideon and the Dog's Quiet Hello | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship grows when we learn the kind of greeting a friend can enjoy.
summary: Button the dog loves to greet everyone with big wiggles. The chickens prefer a calm yard. Gideon teaches Button a quiet hello: sit, soft eyes, one gentle wag, and wait. The chickens come closer on their own, and friendship feels easier for everyone.

title: Hawa's Song for the Chickens
youtube_title: Hawa's Song for the Chickens | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Creativity can turn an ordinary kindness into something joyful and new.
summary: Hawa wants the chickens' breakfast to feel like a tiny celebration. She invents a gentle calling song and decorates the outside of their oat bowls with dry, simple patterns. The chickens come because they wish to, and Hawa learns that making something kind is a creative act.

title: Ioanna Walks Beside the Pony
youtube_title: Ioanna Walks Beside the Pony | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small new step taken with a trusted grown-up close by.
summary: Ioanna feels unsure about walking beside Pippin the pony for the first time. A grown-up stays with them the whole way. They go only as far as the first oak and back. Ioanna learns that courage can be quiet, short, and completely kind.

title: Jasper Tells the Truth about the Spill
youtube_title: Jasper Tells the Truth about the Spill | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honesty helps people fix a mistake quickly and keeps trust strong.
summary: Jasper spills the morning oat scoop and almost blames the wind. He tells the grown-up the truth instead. Together they compost the dusty oats and measure a fresh scoop for the chickens. Honesty makes the fix simple and keeps the morning kind.

title: Kira Brings Shade and Fresh Water
youtube_title: Kira Brings Shade and Fresh Water | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness can be as simple as noticing what a warm day needs and offering comfort.
summary: On a still warm afternoon Kira notices the chickens and Bramble resting in thin shade. With the grown-up she sets out fresh water and hangs a sheet the animals can walk under or around. She learns that kindness is checking on friends and leaving them free.

title: Lorca Waits for the Rain to Pass
youtube_title: Lorca Waits for the Rain to Pass | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience can turn a delay into a gentler, happier plan.
summary: Lorca and Corin have a light picnic ready for Moss to carry when a soft rain begins. Lorca wants to go at once. They wait on the porch until the path is kinder. After the rain they enjoy a brighter meadow and a donkey with surer footing.

title: Maude Speaks Up for a Lighter Load
youtube_title: Maude Speaks Up for a Lighter Load | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can sound like a calm voice that protects a friend.
summary: Rafi, excited for a walk, stacks extra jars into Moss's basket and forgets the light-picnic rule. Maude feels unsure because she is younger, then speaks up kindly. The jars come out, Moss carries only a light load, and everyone thanks Maude for her clear voice.

title: Nabil Shares the Basket of Peas
youtube_title: Nabil Shares the Basket of Peas | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing feels fair when everyone, including you, gets a thoughtful portion.
summary: Nabil picks a basket of peas and wants them all for a snack. Remembering that ducks and chickens enjoy peas, he divides the basket into three fair parts. He learns that sharing can follow a plan so no one is left out and nothing is wasted.

title: Orhan's Questions in the Meadow
youtube_title: Orhan's Questions in the Meadow | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity asks kind questions and is glad to learn, even when the answer is not ready yet.
summary: Orhan walks the meadow with a notebook of gentle questions about the heron, the clover, the pony, and the rabbits. He watches from kind distances, learns some answers, and writes that he does not know yet for the rest. His curiosity stays respectful and wide awake.

title: Penelope and the Extra Apple
youtube_title: Penelope and the Extra Apple | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honesty about a small hidden thing keeps sharing real.
summary: After a light picnic, Penelope finds a second apple in her pocket. She almost keeps it as a secret snack, then tells the truth and brings it back to share. The apple is sliced for everyone, and Penelope learns that honesty protects the joy of a shared day.

title: Rafi and the Pebble Path
youtube_title: Rafi and the Pebble Path | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork turns many light efforts into one sturdy kindness.
summary: After rain, the way to the chickens' dust bath is slick. Rafi invites friends to lay a path of small pebbles. Each person carries only a few stones, Button keeps a quiet watch, and the chickens use the path when they wish. Teamwork stays light and willing.

title: Selma Leaves the Flowers for the Bees
youtube_title: Selma Leaves the Flowers for the Bees | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Caring for nature means leaving enough of the meadow for the creatures who live there.
summary: Selma wants a large bouquet for the table. Watching bees from the path, she sees that the flowers are their pantry. She picks none of the busy blooms, makes a paper bouquet instead, and learns that loving a meadow can mean leaving it as it is.

title: Teo Makes Boats from Fallen Leaves
youtube_title: Teo Makes Boats from Fallen Leaves | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Creativity is especially kind when what we make can return gently to the world.
summary: Teo wants to make something new for a quiet pond afternoon. He uses fallen leaves for little boats and a loose grass ring Bramble can wear or shake off. The ducks nudge the boats if they wish, and Teo learns that creative play can be gentle and temporary.

title: Ursula's Round of Gentle Visits
youtube_title: Ursula's Round of Gentle Visits | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship is remembering how each friend likes to be greeted and showing up with care.
summary: Ursula thinks she must bring a big gift to be a good friend. Walking from the dog to the goat, the heron, the bees, the chickens, and the pony, she offers each the greeting they already enjoy. She learns that a careful visit can be the whole present.

title: The Polite Breeze and the Red Kite
youtube_title: The Polite Breeze and the Red Kite | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Watching small signs and asking questions keeps a wonder from flying away too fast.
summary: Anita wants to know how a kite rises, so she and Luca watch the bush leaves, tip the cloth, and let a polite breeze do the lifting.

title: The Leaf Ruler and the Surprising Puddle
youtube_title: The Leaf Ruler and the Surprising Puddle | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A fair measurement is worth more than a quick guess.
summary: Bjorn and Gracie measure puddle widths and depths with string, chalk, and a leaf ruler, and the narrow puddle turns out deeper than the wide one.

title: The Towel on the Library Steps
youtube_title: The Towel on the Library Steps | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness can sit quietly until a missed sunny hour becomes a rainbow.
summary: Nia thinks the picnic is ruined, so Carmen shares a dry towel, waits with her, and they name the rainbow together.

title: The Potato Boat in a Slow Cloud
youtube_title: The Potato Boat in a Slow Cloud | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A slow cloud can hold two pictures if nobody has to win.
summary: Davin thinks the clouds are plain until he and Paloma wait, then keep both a potato boat and a whale-mitten on their chalk board.

title: Porch Hello, Soft Steps
youtube_title: Porch Hello, Soft Steps | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A friendly sound belongs to both makers when nobody has to win the name.
summary: Elif and Miren hang shells and a moon bead, space them so they do not crowd, and keep both names for the porch chime.

title: A Blanket of Leaves for the Dry Hours
youtube_title: A Blanket of Leaves for the Dry Hours | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A plant stays happier when we plan for the sunny hours, not only the first drink.
summary: Femi and Stig plant with loose soil, a mulch collar, and a noon stone so the roots can find water after the morning drink is gone.

title: Two Songs in the Sun, One Rest in the Shade
youtube_title: Two Songs in the Sun, One Rest in the Shade | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: An extra hat and a shared rest can turn a hot playground into a fair game.
summary: Gracie brings an extra sun hat for squinting Tamsin, and they share two songs in the sun and one rest in the shade.

title: One Hand on the Yellow Rail
youtube_title: One Hand on the Yellow Rail | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a slow walk with a friend, a helper, and a bell.
summary: Haru walks the foggy pier with Oleg and a harbor helper, keeping a hand on the yellow rail and turning back if the paint disappears.

title: The Thunder in Another House
youtube_title: The Thunder in Another House | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying inside and telling the truth about a jumpy feeling is a brave, safe choice.
summary: Inez hears faraway thunder, stays inside with Dad and Jovan, and learns to count, draw, and say how she feels instead of peeking out.

title: Ready and Yours on the Kite Hill
youtube_title: Ready and Yours on the Kite Hill | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A team lifts higher when the jobs stay fair and the words stay small.
summary: Jovan watches the string and Kesia offers the cloth, then they trade so the breeze, not a hero, lifts the kite.

title: The Patience Clock for a Late Rainbow
youtube_title: The Patience Clock for a Late Rainbow | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A rainbow needs a moment for sun and rain to meet.
summary: Kesia wants the rainbow to hurry, so Rina helps her sip, look, and keep her hands quiet until the bow stands over the far trees.

title: Where the Fog Leaves First
youtube_title: Where the Fog Leaves First | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity can watch a fog give the harbor back without rushing the white air.
summary: Luca and Haru study one mast, the bell, and the crates, and write that the friendly fog clears from the top and in patches.

title: A Shell Reminder of Light Rain
youtube_title: A Shell Reminder of Light Rain | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making can stop when the sound is close enough and the rests are still there.
summary: Miren and Elif test shells, beads, and a spoon until their wind chime sounds like light rain with rests, then leave it uncrowded.

title: The Deep Green Hat for a Squinting Row
youtube_title: The Deep Green Hat for a Squinting Row | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness starts when you notice a squint and a thirsty can.
summary: Nia sees Femi squinting without his hat, offers a deep green one, and moves the hot watering can into the shade before they water the roots slowly.

title: The Coin Puddle and the Soil Pantry
youtube_title: The Coin Puddle and the Soil Pantry | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Water teaches two lessons when one puddle vanishes and another stays cool.
summary: Oleg and Bjorn watch a stone puddle shrink to a coin while the soil keeps a cool pantry, then mulch a crack so roots can use the drink.

title: The Bridge Cloud and the Long Loaf
youtube_title: The Bridge Cloud and the Long Loaf | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a sky does not use it up.
summary: Paloma feels grabby about the best cloud, then takes turns with Davin so the same sky can be a bridge, a loaf, and a mitten.

title: The Knot That Was Not the Wind
youtube_title: The Knot That Was Not the Wind | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saying the true part lets a tangle become a clear string.
summary: Quinlan almost blames the breeze for a wobble, then admits he twisted the string and helps Jovan wind it clear.

title: Puddles First, Then the Hill
youtube_title: Puddles First, Then the Hill | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Two good wishes can both fit when friends choose the order together.
summary: Rina wants to follow the puddle pieces and Carmen wants the hill, so they do both walks and keep the rainbow wide enough for two wishes.

title: Four Pats and a Cool Drink
youtube_title: Four Pats and a Cool Drink | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is a pattern of digging, placing, patting, and sharing the drink.
summary: Stig and Inez dig, place, pat, mulch, and water three seedlings together so no plant gets a bigger drink than the others.

title: Seven Counts Between a Far Rumbling
youtube_title: Seven Counts Between a Far Rumbling | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Brave and close can be the same thing when you stay in and say how you feel.
summary: Tamsin hears distant thunder, stays inside with Mom and Anita, counts the gap after the flicker, and tells them when a rumble still startles her.

title: The Cup That Learned to Stand
youtube_title: The Cup That Learned to Stand | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets careful hands turn a wobble into something that can hold.
summary: Agnes and Barak shape an air-dry clay cup that cracks and leans. They slow down, mend the crack with gentle rubs, add a handle, and paint it in patient bands. By evening the cup holds warm milk, and they feel quietly proud without calling it the best.

title: A Pillow for the Quiet Chair
youtube_title: A Pillow for the Quiet Chair | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A kindness you can lean on is made of careful stitches and shared work.
summary: Celine and Dario sew a pillow so Auntie's reading chair will feel gentler. Uneven stitches get eased, stuffing is spread so no lump hides, and Auntie stands by for the last snip. They give the pillow without a boast, and it does its quiet job.

title: The Stamp That Faced the Other Way
youtube_title: The Stamp That Faced the Other Way | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity asks what happened, then tries again to learn the answer.
summary: Esme and Fabio print leaves, stars, and dots. A letter comes out backward, so they test until they see that a stamp shows its other face. A sleeve smudge becomes a cloud, and they hang a finished banner that tells what they learned.

title: Two Boats in One Basin
youtube_title: Two Boats in One Basin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing space and supplies can make play feel bigger, not smaller.
summary: Gul and Hester fold paper boats and float them in a wash basin. They trade turns in the middle. When one boat gets soggy, they share paper, fold a stronger boat, and turn the tired one into a little dish. The basin stays a basin.

title: Knots for Two Wrists
youtube_title: Knots for Two Wrists | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship can be a row of gentle knots that leave room to be yourself.
summary: Imani and Jules knot friendship bracelets for each other, using favorite colors. Lumpy knots are undone and a tangle is opened slowly. They trade jobs so both hands are in each gift, and they wear the finished bracelets without pinching or bragging.

title: The Little House for Small Wings
youtube_title: The Little House for Small Wings | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork means each person does a needed job, including the quiet ones.
summary: Kofi and Laila paint a birdhouse from wood Uncle already cut and smoothed. They hold the pieces while Uncle fits them, choose a shady middle-height spot, and set out seed and water. The finished house waits calmly for birds.

title: Socks That Found Their Voices
youtube_title: Socks That Found Their Voices | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Creativity can turn an ordinary scrap into a story with room for surprises.
summary: Marco and Nura turn two socks into a baker puppet and a gardener puppet. Mama sews the button eyes. A tumble and runaway pretend berries become part of the play, solved with a napkin ramp. They rest the finished puppets on the sill.

title: The Castle with a Wide Base
youtube_title: The Castle with a Wide Base | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small nod and one more try after something tips.
summary: Oona and Piotr build a cardboard castle. A tower box slides off, and Oona feels fluttery, then agrees to one new way. Tape and a wider hug make the lookout stay. They finish a door, a flag, and a welcome card, proud in a steady way.

title: Gold from Onion Skins
youtube_title: Gold from Onion Skins | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Nature shares color if you notice, wait, and handle the warm parts with care.
summary: Queisha and Rowan gather dry onion skins. Grandpa steeps them and keeps the hot pot. After the dye cools, the children stir, rinse, and hang a golden cloth, then kindly redip a pale corner. The finished napkin remembers the garden.

title: The Scarf That Told the Truth
youtube_title: The Scarf That Told the Truth | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honesty about a mistake makes it easier to mend and finish with pride.
summary: Sana knits a scarf and almost hides an extra loop that makes the edge wave. She tells Timo the truth. Together they ease the loop and later pick up a dropped stitch. The finished wonky scarf warms Grandpa's knees.

title: Two Cups from One Lump
youtube_title: Two Cups from One Lump | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing at the start keeps a project fair and friendly to the end.
summary: Barak and Celine divide one lump of clay into two cups, trading pieces until the mounds feel fair. They share blue paint in turns and make a small dish from scraps. Both cups hold water, and neither one is ranked above the other.

title: Stitches That Took Their Time
youtube_title: Stitches That Took Their Time | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience is pausing, unpicking, and trying a corner again with shorter steps.
summary: Dario and Esme sew a pillow for the hard window seat. A knot is loosened, a puckered corner is unpicked, and they rest every ten stitches. The finished yellow pillow gives elbows a soft place in the sun.

title: Hills Rain and a Walking Tree
youtube_title: Hills Rain and a Walking Tree | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Creativity grows when you keep a surprise and give it a job.
summary: Fabio and Gul block-print a picnic cloth with hills, leaves, and windy rain. A half leaf becomes a walking tree, and a sleeve smear becomes a pond. They finish the cloth and eat a careful snack on their made-up landscape.

title: Boats That Carried Kind Words
youtube_title: Boats That Carried Kind Words | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship grows when kind words are made, sent, and kept.
summary: Hester and Imani fold paper boats and float short kind notes across a basin. A soggy boat retires as a note holder, and a new shared boat carries two messages at once. They hang the dry notes where they can read them again.

title: Three Bracelets and a Good Morning
youtube_title: Three Bracelets and a Good Morning | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness notices someone's ordinary help and says thank you with your hands.
summary: Jules and Kofi knot three bracelets, one for each other and one for the neighbor who brings good mornings with the letters. They redo a gap so the gift is comfortable, deliver it kindly, and keep two bracelets for their own wrists.

title: A Perch Beside the Mint
youtube_title: A Perch Beside the Mint | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Nature shows you where a made thing belongs if you listen and watch.
summary: Laila and Marco pause their painting to watch a small bird. They help Auntie place the finished birdhouse at middle height near the mint, with a clean perch, seed, and water. The bird samples a seed, and they keep listening.

title: A Play with Two Pairs of Hands
youtube_title: A Play with Two Pairs of Hands | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is planning together and pausing when you disagree.
summary: Nura and Oona use sock puppets to tell about a bridge and a pretend river. When a plank is placed in the deep part, they pause, use real voices, and choose a better spot together. The picnic crosses, and the puppets rest finished on the sill.

title: Windows That Wanted to Open
youtube_title: Windows That Wanted to Open | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity tests one question at a time until the answer fits in your hands.
summary: Piotr and Queisha explore a cardboard castle. They learn why it echoes, ask Papa to make a hinge hole while they hold the edges, and discover a loose thread loop that lets a flag spin. They draw the answers on the inside wall.

title: Purple That Would Not Rush
youtube_title: Purple That Would Not Rush | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honesty keeps you from pretending a job is done before it truly is.
summary: Rowan and Sana dye cloth with cool berry juice. The color stays pale, and Sana admits she wants to pretend it is bright. They wait, add more berries, and tell Grandpa the truth about the freckle and the slow middle. The purple cover is finished.

title: The First Loop
youtube_title: The First Loop | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a tiny first try, and a second try in the same minute.
summary: Timo is nervous about knitting a first loop. Agnes shows slowly without taking his needles. A dropped stitch is picked up, the mark of the repair stays, and the finished wonky blue scarf goes on the reading chair as a true, warm gift.

title: The Slow Sunday Pancakes
youtube_title: The Slow Sunday Pancakes | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience is taking care while you wait.
summary: Amina wants Sunday pancakes right away and flips the first one before it is ready. Grandma Elena shows her how to watch for bubbles and gives her small jobs during the wait. The next pancakes turn golden, and Amina learns that patience can be active and calm.

title: The Blanket Mountain Game
youtube_title: The Blanket Mountain Game | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork can turn a big job into a kind game.
summary: Boris and Chiara's play leaves the bedroom full of socks, books, and blankets. They feel overwhelmed until they invent a tidy game with a map keeper, a guide, and gentle rules. Together they put every item home and leave a sign so the next playtime can begin kindly.

title: The Tiny Balcony Forest
youtube_title: The Tiny Balcony Forest | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Nature can thrive in small places when we care for it gently.
summary: Deepak thinks the balcony pots are too small to matter until Grandpa Kamal shows him mint, climbing beans, and a tomato flower. They plant basil seeds, mend a rushed watering, and start a leaf journal. Deepak learns that nature grows with steady, gentle care.

title: The Cinnamon Truth
youtube_title: The Cinnamon Truth | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth helps a mistake become something you can fix.
summary: Habiba adds too much cinnamon to Grandma Lotta's honey rice and hides the jar. The pot tastes too strong. Habiba tells the truth, and together they balance the rice, then write the recipe on a card so the next memory starts with an honest question.

title: Little News for Ivan
youtube_title: Little News for Ivan | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kind, true news can warm someone who lives far away.
summary: Finn misses cousin Ivan, who lives in another town, and stares at a blank page. Grandma Noelle helps him send small kitchen news, a drawing of Ivan's chair, and a humming spot by the sink. Mailing the letter turns the missing feeling into a kindness on its way.

title: Questions for the Photo Album
youtube_title: Questions for the Photo Album | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity grows kinder when we stay long enough to listen.
summary: Joy wants to race through every old photo. Grandpa Ivan invites her questions and lingers on yellow curtains, a cup drummer, and a balcony visit. Joy and cousin Omar add a drawing of their own afternoon to an empty pocket in the album.

title: The Wooden Spoon Orchestra
youtube_title: The Wooden Spoon Orchestra | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Creativity can turn ordinary kitchen things into shared music.
summary: Rain keeps Malik, Pema, and Vijay indoors, so they build a band from pots, wooden spoons, and a rice tin. A noisy muddle becomes a layered soup song with a brave quiet part. They name the band The Whisper Tin and leave a picture map for the next rainy visit.

title: A Small Hello at the Big Table
youtube_title: A Small Hello at the Big Table | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be one true sentence and one kind action.
summary: Una feels shy at a crowded family table and takes the chair beside the bread. Cousin Tomas asks a gentle question, and Una manages a small yes, passes the basket, and mentions her new mint leaf. Her shyness stays, and her courage sits right beside it.

title: Soft Steps for a New Baby
youtube_title: Soft Steps for a New Baby | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness can be busy even when the room must stay quiet.
summary: Chiara wants to play loud blocks, but new baby cousin Rafael is asleep. She chooses quiet jobs instead, smoothing a blanket, drawing a picture, and humming a whisper song. The calm afternoon makes her feel included, tender, and proud.

title: One Bowl and Two Spoons
youtube_title: One Bowl and Two Spoons | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing feels fuller when everyone uses fair, friendly turns.
summary: Lotta and Finn both want the last mango and notice their grabby feelings. Grandma Elena cuts the fruit into one bowl with two spoons. The cousins take turns, describe each piece, and write the rules down for the next time there is only one treat.

title: The Shady Corner Friend
youtube_title: The Shady Corner Friend | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A friend helps by noticing the problem and sharing the work.
summary: Amina's basil droops, and she feels guilty. Her friend Boris sees that the pot is sitting in harsh sun. Together they move it to a shady corner, water it gently, and promise to be noticing friends the next time something needs help.

title: Two Names on the Card
youtube_title: Two Names on the Card | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honesty keeps praise wide enough for everyone who helped.
summary: Tomas draws pots and Joy draws flowers for Grandma Soraya. Tomas almost signs only his own name, then tells Joy the truth before the card is given. Both names go on the garden, and the cousins keep a reminder that shared work gets shared thanks.

title: The Curious Bowl of Dough
youtube_title: The Curious Bowl of Dough | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity asks, waits, and looks carefully again.
summary: Finn wants to know why a quiet bowl of dough grows bigger. Grandma Elena explains the tiny yeast helpers and lets him draw the before and the after. He waits for the timer, peeks once with care, and finds a soft pillow full of hidden bubbles.

title: Many Jobs for One Breakfast
youtube_title: Many Jobs for One Breakfast | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork means every job helps the whole table.
summary: Malik, Joy, and Una all want the pancake spoon at once. Grandma Noelle helps them name every job, from washing berries to watching bubbles. They take turns, share the prettiest pancake, and tape a chart that shows no job is smaller than the others.

title: The Softest Tap
youtube_title: The Softest Tap | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can begin with one gentle try.
summary: Noelle wants to join the family band but fears making a wrong tap. Vijay, Pema, and Grandma Lotta make room for a soft part and a kind loop. Noelle plays one doorway note, recovers from an early tap, and learns that gentle bravery belongs in the song.

title: The Pillow Line
youtube_title: The Pillow Line | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing can turn one favorite spot into fair, friendly turns.
summary: Omar and Tomas both want the window side of the bed where the morning light lands. They feel tight, then build a pillow line, trade nights, and open the curtain together. Each side becomes a good side once the sunrise is shared instead of grabbed.

title: One Picture Then the Story
youtube_title: One Picture Then the Story | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a story finish before the next page turns.
summary: Pema wants to flip the album quickly to find the best picture. Grandpa Kamal asks her to stay with one rainy indoor picnic and hold the ribbon until the story ends. She hears about spoon tent poles and a slow tomato, then saves the rest of the pages for next time.

title: Leaves Left on the Stem
youtube_title: Leaves Left on the Stem | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Nature stays generous when we take only enough.
summary: Una wants a huge handful of mint so the soup will taste louder. Grandma Soraya and cousin Amina show her how to snip a few sprigs and leave the growing tips. The soup smells wonderful, and the plant stays leafy for another day.

title: A Letter Made of Pictures
youtube_title: A Letter Made of Pictures | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Creativity can carry kind news when words feel hard.
summary: Habiba misses cousin Lotta and feels stuck after the first word of a letter. With Grandpa Kamal's encouragement she draws the kitchen, a saved stool, a cloud pancake, mint, and a path between towns. Sending the pictures makes the missing feel seen and gently connected.

title: A Song From Two Kitchens
youtube_title: A Song From Two Kitchens | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship has room for two ways of doing something.
summary: Chiara's home clap and Deepak's spoon tap collide when they try to play at once. They feel wobbly, then teach each other slowly and blend a new pattern with room for both. Each cousin keeps a copy so the same gentle song can live in two kitchens.

title: The Drooping Lip of the Moon-White Pitcher
youtube_title: The Drooping Lip of the Moon-White Pitcher | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting a little and trying again with a slower hand can shape what hurry keeps bending.
summary: Yara is making a small moon-white cream pitcher for the fountain flower cups, but the pouring lip keeps drooping. She waits through three kind chimes, mists the clay, and shapes the lip slowly so the water pours in one clear line.

title: The Red Scarf on the Ferry Bell
youtube_title: The Red Scarf on the Ferry Bell | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing a small loose thing and helping to fix it lets other people feel included.
summary: Zayd rides the slow ferry with a grown-up and notices the red signal scarf has slipped from the kind bell, so walkers on the bridge cannot see the boat coming. He helps the ferry guide retie it where it can be seen.

title: The Brass Fish Clip on the Book Barge
youtube_title: The Brass Fish Clip on the Book Barge | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curious listening can find what a hurry would miss.
summary: On the book barge, wind keeps closing the map-book page that shows the hill orchard because the brass fish page-clip is missing. Anouk follows a tiny jingle to a barrel of spare cushions and finds the clip caught on a thread.

title: The Wide Strap of the Peach Basket
youtube_title: The Wide Strap of the Peach Basket | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a slow walk beside a grown-up, one peach at a time.
summary: Bima wants to carry a tall peach basket with a wide leather strap down the orchard path, but the strap feels too big and he worries the fruit will bump. With the orchard keeper beside him, he carries a shorter row, one peach at a time, and finds the basket steady.

title: The Last Pot of River-Blue Paint
youtube_title: The Last Pot of River-Blue Paint | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a small amount, used with care, can finish two kind parts of the same picture.
summary: Cressida has the last small pot of river-blue paint for the community mural. Both the painted ferry window and a friend's sky puddle need blue. She shares the pot and uses a thin brush so each place gets enough.

title: The Little Wooden Wedge of the Kind Chime
youtube_title: The Little Wooden Wedge of the Kind Chime | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing a change in a familiar sound, and telling someone kindly, helps the whole plaza.
summary: Dalia hears that the clock tower's kind chime sounds stuffed and sleepy. With a grown-up she visits the bright clock room and finds the tiny wooden wedge, which keeps the hammer resting kindly, lying on the stair. They put it back so the chime rings clear again.

title: The Leaf Sail That Spun in Circles
youtube_title: The Leaf Sail That Spun in Circles | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Changing one small part can help a whole idea work.
summary: Eero's cork-and-leaf boat spins in circles in the plaza fountain because the leaf sail is too wide. He folds the sail smaller and adds a light pebble weight so the boat can travel calmly to the smiling stone turtle.

title: The Wooden Fish That Faced the Wrong Way
youtube_title: The Wooden Fish That Faced the Wrong Way | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork turns mixed-up markers back into a clear, welcoming path.
summary: Three painted wooden fish that show the safe walking side of the bridge have turned backward in a breeze. Farah cannot reach the cord alone. She works with the bridge mender and a small neighbor to turn the fish the right way.

title: The Bent Rib of the Persimmon Lamp
youtube_title: The Bent Rib of the Persimmon Lamp | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A gentle, patient hand can straighten what a quick pull might crumple.
summary: At the early evening fruit market, Gio sees a persimmon-shaped paper lamp with a bent wire rib, so the light hides the pale fruit slices. He wants to yank the wire. The lamp maker shows him how to warm his hands and ease the rib back a little at a time.

title: The Square Cushion on the Round Rug
youtube_title: The Square Cushion on the Round Rug | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship sometimes means moving what you like so someone else can sit close.
summary: Hanan's reading circle on the plaza has a round rug, but her big square cushion fills the middle so two friends cannot see the borrowed picture book. She moves the cushion to the edge and makes room.

title: The Green Tiles That Were Meant to Be Gray
youtube_title: The Green Tiles That Were Meant to Be Gray | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early lets a mix-up become useful instead of hidden.
summary: Ilaria swaps two glaze cups, so her little bridge-shaped test tiles come out leaf-green instead of water-gray. She almost hides them, then tells the potter kindly. The green tiles become orchard leaves on the mural plan instead of a wasted mistake.

title: The Seed Inside the Reed Pointer
youtube_title: The Seed Inside the Reed Pointer | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity about a small odd feeling can clear the way for everyone to follow a story.
summary: On the book barge, the hollow reed pointer snags on the page because a dried seed is stuck inside. Jaleel asks to look, eases the seed out, and the reader can guide the lines again. They plant the seed in a cup on the barge.

title: The Tipped Saucer Under the Pear Tree
youtube_title: The Tipped Saucer Under the Pear Tree | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Noticing what a young tree needs is a quiet way of caring for nature.
summary: Ksenia notices that a clay rain saucer under a young pear tree has tipped, so water runs away from the roots while neighboring trees still glisten. With the orchard keeper she levels the saucer and tucks leaves around the roots like a blanket.

title: The Lemon Tin on the Slow Ferry
youtube_title: The Lemon Tin on the Slow Ferry | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a favorite thing can make a slow ride feel generous and sweet.
summary: Leandro holds a tin of lemon slices meant for everyone's warm mint tea on the slow ferry. He wants them all. When he sees there is enough for one slice each, he offers the tin around, and the shared sweetness makes the ride feel wider.

title: The Sponge Stamp That Printed Blobs
youtube_title: The Sponge Stamp That Printed Blobs | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Trying a lighter touch can turn a blob into the shape you hoped for.
summary: Mireille's seed-shaped sponge stamp prints blobs on the mural's orchard corner because it is too wet. She tries again by blotting, pressing lightly, and lifting straight, until a row of clear seeds appears.

title: The Paper Sun Caught in the Rosemary
youtube_title: The Paper Sun Caught in the Rosemary | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness can be speaking up when you see that someone, even a paper sun, has been left out.
summary: At noon the clock keeper lowers a basket of folded paper suns so children can count the kind chimes. One sun is caught on a rosemary sprig in the window box. Nassim notices, tells the keeper, and folds a spare so the count still has enough.

title: The Counting Stones in the Bridge Pocket
youtube_title: The Counting Stones in the Bridge Pocket | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Helping to put small things back makes a shared place welcoming again.
summary: The sea-blue cloth pocket on the bridge rail has gaped, and ten dotted counting stones have spilled into a dry groove. Orla gathers them and learns a simple knot from the bridge mender so the pocket will hold again.

title: The Pebble Under the Starfruit Tray
youtube_title: The Pebble Under the Starfruit Tray | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is each person doing one small safe part so the whole job holds.
summary: A stack of cane starfruit trays leans because a pebble sits under one foot. Puck steadies the stack but cannot sweep the pebble alone. With the fruit seller and a lamp helper, they lift a little, sweep, and set the tray flat together.

title: The Puzzle Petal Under the Lily Leaves
youtube_title: The Puzzle Petal Under the Lily Leaves | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets the water bring back what a rush would push farther away.
summary: One wooden petal of the fountain's floating lily puzzle has drifted under the real leaves. Ruya wants to stir the water quickly. The fountain minder shows her how to wait and watch the slow turn of the water until the petal comes around to her hands.

title: The Thumb Dent in the Plum Cup
youtube_title: The Thumb Dent in the Plum Cup | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest friends can tell the truth kindly and try a careful fix together.
summary: Soren makes two cream cups with plum-purple rims for sharing juice at the studio window, but his thumb leaves a dent he hopes no one will see. He tells his friend the truth, and together they smooth the dent and shape the cup again.
